svg.title: GATR field coordinates and robot heading
svg.desc: Configured Override field: red at x zero, blue at maximum x, audience at y zero. X increases right, Y increases up. Heading zero faces blue; positive heading is counterclockwise.

g.text: naviGATR / spectaGATR | Configured Override field | Top-down audience view
FORWARD IS RELATIVE TO THE ROBOT
Field X and Y stay fixed when the robot turns.
Startup assigns this pose; it does not detect placement.
Use the viewer’s Top Down button for this orientation.
Orbiting the camera does not change field coordinates.
Inside field: 140.4 × 140.4 in (3.5664 × 3.5664 m). Nominal geometry from config/override/field.xml.
Robot drawings illustrate heading, not starting positions. Goals, loaders, toggles and tape are drawn from the configured field.
